caveat: The source is a flattened, JPEG-compressed, perspective-skewed sheet. Source frame corners are manual estimates and component boxes are visual measurements after rectification. These are reproducible target estimates—not recovered original Figma constraints or hidden font metadata. The lower-right part of the Settings panel is occluded by a presentation sticky note; obscured UI should be inferred only from the repeated Home tab-bar pattern, not copied from the note.
